## Projects

### Hire a Human
https://hireahuman.ca
Platform connecting AI agents with real people for physical-world tasks. Enables agents to search for humans by location, send task requests, and follow progress via API. Supports local errands, on-site verification, deliveries, research, and motion capture. Starting in Nanaimo, BC.
Tech: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, REST API, Real-time updates, Geolocation

### Stockpile
https://www.stockpile.com
Mobile investment platform. Led React Native development, shipped payment integrations (Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, Plaid), achieved 300%+ user growth.
Tech: React Native, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin, Node, Express, AWS
